hints.title: Distinct Target Elements
hints.text: Because all elements of target are distinct, every target element maps to a unique index.

hints.title: Map Array to Target Indices
hints.text: Replace each element in arr with its index in target, discarding numbers that do not appear in target.

hints.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence Reduction
hints.text: The longest common subsequence between target and arr equals the longest increasing subsequence of mapped indices.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Classic O(n * m) dynamic programming times out when n and m reach 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mapping distinct target elements to indices reduces LCS to patience sort LIS in O(m log m) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes uniqueness of target elements to reduce LCS to O(m log m) binary search LIS.
